svg.title: The right side proves differentiability. If B = u′(0), differentiating the group law gives u′(t) = u(t)B, whence d dt[u(t)e−tB] = 0. Evaluation at zero yields u(t) = etB. For each finite-dimensional field space this gives the entire complex extension u(z) = ezB of its boost representation. Fix the finite field space containing the finitely many labels. For a boundary configuration Z0, take the small imaginary-boost endpoint it just constructed and define near Z0
